title: Creamy Pineapple Cucumber Smoothie
summary: I love starting my day with a creamy pineapple cucumber smoothie with banana. It is refreshing, packed with wholesome ingredients, and takes me just 5 minutes to make.
ingredients: 1 cup chopped baby spinach and kale mix
steps: Place all ingredients into a high speed blender.
Blend until smooth, scraping down the sides as needed.
Adjust thickness by adding water if needed.
